newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $4 bln for week of Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $4 bln for week of Nov 18.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $4 billion in 168 offerings for the week of Nov 18, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $1.1 billion in 102 offerings. The largest is a two-part $250 million San Francisco deal on Tuesday.
Negotiated sales total $2.9 billion in 66 offerings. The largest issue is a $325 million San Francisco Building Authority issue through BA Securities.

There are 15 issues totaling $814 million on the day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have indicated they may price them this week depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
